messages:
mira: Quick sync — proposing 'attributed-rollout' behavior: every rollout must attach rollout_id to metrics/traces and support a preview API.
aj: +1. Rollout_id is critical. How do we surface it in dashboards?
ryan: Plan: add rollout_id tag on span/metric and emit a compact decision event when routing switches. Sample events for high-traffic cohorts.
leah: UX: in console show a "change attribution" toggle so users can filter by rollout_id and see cohort-level sparklines. Also expose unpause audit.
config-bot: note: "rollout attributed by mira at 3521112223"
sam: Implementation note: preview endpoint GET /rollouts/:id/preview?cohort=... should return simulated decision + reason codes, no side-effects. We'll need a proto for that.
mira: Ops: require unpause_comment + user_id for manual overrides. Limit unpause to owner+oncall.
aj: lint: block rollouts without sampling config and rollout_id annotation.
ryan: Edge: telemetry outage — treat as "metrics-unavailable" and pause advancement, send alert.
leah: Action items: sam (preview proto), ryan (decision event), leah (console filter + sparkline), aj (lint). config-bot: record actions.
config-bot: actions recorded: sam, ryan, leah, aj
